claims.value: open-source MoE model with 1.02T total params and 42B active params
claims.evidence: MiMo-V2.5-Pro is an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 1.02T total parameters and 42B active parameters.

It utilizes the hybrid attention architecture and 3-layers Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) introduced in [MiMo-V2-Flash](https://github.com/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash), with up to 1M tokens context length.

The paradigm begins with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to build strong, foundational instruction-following skills... Next, in the Domain-Specialized Training stage... Finally, the process culminates in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD).
MiMo V2.5 Pro delivers a major leap in long-context reasoning.
